name: Barabás (Hungary)
description: A vertical white banner with a serrated border of red and green triangles, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Barabás (a blue and red shield with a white lamb and a bunch of grapes) above a scroll inscribed BARABÁS.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: serrated border of red and green triangles
